definitions.explanation: The biological or social distinction between male and female.

notes:
{性別|せいべつ} refers to sex or gender, the distinction between male (⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧) and female (⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {性別|せいべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わず→問う：02299_tou⟧: regardless of gender
- {性別|せいべつ}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: gender field (on forms)
- {性別|せいべつ}⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧: gender role
- {性別|せいべつ}⟦{分業|ぶんぎょう}→分業：09617_bungyou⟧: division of labor by gender

FORM OPTIONS (traditional):
- ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧/⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧: male
- ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧/⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: female

Modern forms may include additional options or allow self-identification.

RELATED WORDS:
- ジェンダー: gender (social concept, loanword)
- ⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧: both sexes, men and women
